name: Fat Pack | 1.5g Preroll | Bustin Suds
description: Fat J: 1.5 Gram Preroll - a half gram better. Lemon Haze x Do-Si-Dos create Bustin’ Suds, an uplifting, social strain with fizzy citrus sweetness. Its terpene mix of Limonene, Caryophyllene, and Pinene makes it energetic and creative while offering mild body ease. A fun and refreshing option for day or night.
